name: Pullquote — cinematic demo
description: Hero demo for the pullquote-on-photo Surface. Atmospheric warm-key backdrop via the pullquote-photo-backdrop shaderPass (radial warmth gradient + multi-octave noise + warm focal halo + heavy edge vignette) with a centred serif quote and mono attribution. Pushes the engine toward film-grade compositing rather than card-with-text. Built to demonstrate what the Pipeline catalog is actually capable of when content and shader work together.

content.title: The work that lasts is the work that responds gracefully to weather you did not predict.
content.author: Wes Bos, Syntax Notebooks
